messages:
incident-bot: [P1] Observability alert — rapid KV cache growth detected (host-level >20GB, sustained 5m), correlated 95th/99th token latency spike in us-west-2. Paging oncall @alex @maria. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/kv-cache/blowup ; runbook: https://wiki/internal/ops/kv-cache

alex: seeing the page. looking at graphs + logs. has anyone reproduced locally? grabbing trace ids and the runbook.

kevin: I'm available. any immediate mitigations we can flip?

maria: root cause looks like a regression in continuous batching that multiplies KV prefix keys for some workload patterns — leads to cache blowup and perf cliff. immediate safe mitigation: disable continuous_batching via feature-flag for a small canary cohort (region-based) and apply per-customer overrides for the largest tenants.

alex: ok. maria, can you post the CLI we should run? I'll execute from the control plane.

maria: running now. command to create a canary rollout (us-west-2, 10%):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://controlplane.internal/flags/batch-config \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"flag":"continuous_batching","value":false,"selector":{"region":"us-west-2","percent":10}}'
```
Check status: \n```bash
curl -s https://controlplane.internal/flags/status?flag=continuous_batching
# expected: {"ok":true, "rollout": {"percent":10, "regions":["us-west-2"]}}
```

maria: per-customer override example (enterprise-123, fintech-prod):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://controlplane.internal/flags/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"continuous_batching","value":false,"customers":["enterprise-123","fintech-prod"]}'
```

deploy-bot: Feature flag request accepted. rollout_id=ff-20260315-001. queued for gradual apply.

alex: applying canary now (initiating from console). will watch error rates and kv metrics.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: ff-20260315-001 -> region:us-west-2 percent:10.

kevin: started collecting heap/tracing on canary hosts. will tail logs for kv-store churn.

sre-rotations: 2m after canary apply: observed 95th token latency drop (canary subset) from ~320ms to ~70-90ms. KV cache growth rate on canary hosts normalized. no obvious error spike.

product-ops: flagged: we saw small retry bursts for a handful of API keys tied to background batching jobs, impact <1% requests, customers notified: enterprise-123 (noticing), beta-corp (monitoring).

alex: good. plan: if canary remains stable for 10m, expand to 50% then to 100%. maria, please prepare an automated rollback command in case errors increase.

maria: rollback command ready: 
```bash
# rollback to previous rollout
curl -s -X POST https://controlplane.internal/flags/rollback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"rollout_id":"ff-20260315-001"}'
```

alex: increasing canary to 50% now.

deploy-bot: Rollout update: ff-20260315-001 -> percent:50.

sre-rotations: metrics after percent increase (5m): tail latency improved cluster-wide for flagged cohort. KV index churn dropped to baseline. no new error patterns.

maria: expanding per-customer overrides to cover the handful of tenants that saw transient retries. applied overrides for enterprise-123, fintech-prod, beta-corp.

deploy-bot: Rollout update: ff-20260315-001 -> percent:100. Rollout completed.

kevin: verified cache size across hosts returning to normal. sampling logs show fewer duplicated prefix writes.

product-ops: customer impact summary: 3 customers observed minor retrying during rollout window (max 3m), no data loss, support tickets created for enterprise-123 (severity low).

alex: incident status: mitigated -> expanding to full rollout completed. moving to resolved once we confirm no regression in 30m. next steps: revert temporary per-customer overrides in 24h unless otherwise requested; follow-up RCA and an automated load test for high key-sharing patterns. assign RCA to kevin.

kevin: ack. will start RCA and add a replay test to our infra repo.

maria: created a tracking ticket: https://tickets.internal/ISSUE-4721 "KV-cache blowup: continuous batching regression" and added owners + monitoring alerts.

incident-bot: Incident resolved — P1 -> Resolved. duration ~00:28:00. links: incident timeline: https://incidents.internal/1795001234, RCA: ISSUE-4721. :white_check_mark:

alex: thanks team. postmortem to include: how feature-flag canary selection missed an edge-case where small tenants caused disproportionate prefix duplication, add unit tests to flagging infra, and a runbook update for faster per-customer override steps.

maria: will follow up with a patch to batching logic (prevent duplicate prefix emission) and a test harness PR.

product-ops: sending customer comms template now.

alex: closing thread. :thumbsup:
